column2: After all, you're going to die here!
I am Lord $$ユダ$$, the great $$大神官$$ who boasts flawless beauty!
S-so persistent! You damn queen of a $$神官$$!
Don't you go praising my $$嫉妬$$, my greatest virtue!
Did you really think something that minor would reform me and make me give up revenge against you!?
Really, couldn't you at least take the precaution of cutting off your opponent's head to finish them in battle?
Y-you... Could you be $$強欲$$'s $$マモン$$!?
To begin with, thinking you could kill me—a proud vampire—with...
What a nuisance—nothing but small fry who can barely move.
$$異端審問官$$s, deal with them neatly, will you?
After all, the only one I'm interested in is my $$愛$$ly $$ダーリン$$!
What are you making eyes at my $$カイン$$ for!?
$$おにいちゃん$$... is $$プリカ$$'s $$奴隷$$!
